source_data.prob_desc_description: Kirill plays a new computer game. He came to the potion store where he can buy any potion. Efficiency may be a non-integer number.For each two integer numbers a and b such that l ≤ a ≤ r and x ≤ b ≤ y there is a potion with experience a and cost b in the store (that is, there are (r - l + 1)·(y - x + 1) potions).Kirill wants to buy a potion which has efficiency k. Will he be able to do this?
